_meta.method: The initial 26 operator pages were fetched on 2026-11-01; rows with their own checkedOn date were re-read on that date. A field is filled in ONLY if its value appeared on the cited official page on the row check date. Fields not seen are left blank (null). Rechecks do not certify other rows or linked pages.

levels.verified: Free-entry, prize and open/closed status were all read from the cited official page.
levels.partial: At least one field was read from the official page; one or more fields are still blank/unverified.
levels.contradicted: The official page contradicts the upstream ledger on a material point (entry fee, ended, wrong figure, dead link). See discrepancies.

cbs-pro-pickem.sourceLabel: CBSSports.com 2026 Pro Football Pick'em Official Rules
cbs-pro-pickem.freeEntry: Yes — "The Challenge is FREE to play. No purchase, wireless device or entry fee necessary."
cbs-pro-pickem.prize: 18 weekly prizes of $1,000 each (check); one $5,000 season-long prize; $100,000 contingency prize shared by anyone who picks every game correctly in a week AND predicts the exact scores of both tiebreaker games.
cbs-pro-pickem.eligibility: Registered CBSI-network users who are legal residents of the 50 US states or DC (Puerto Rico and territories excluded) and 18+ (or age of majority). One entry per person.
cbs-pro-pickem.dates: Early sign-up from 2026-07-20; contest runs 2026-09-09 to 2027-01-10 (18 weekly periods)
notes: The $100,000 is NOT a perfect-bracket-style prize for most players: it requires a perfect week plus exact tiebreaker scores.

discrepancies.official: Matches, but the $100K requires a perfect week AND exact scores for both tiebreaker games (Section 3, Contingency Prize).

mlb-beat-the-streak.sourceLabel: MLB Beat the Streak 2026 Official Rules
mlb-beat-the-streak.freeEntry: Yes — "NO PURCHASE NECESSARY"; "MLB.com account and BTS registration are both free."
mlb-beat-the-streak.prize: Grand Prize $5,600,000 (30-year annuity of $186,667/yr OR $3,000,000 lump sum valued as of 2026-03-12) — awarded only for a streak of 57+. If no one reaches 57, a $10,000 Top Streak Prize goes to the best streak of at least 20. If nobody reaches 20, no prize is awarded.
mlb-beat-the-streak.eligibility: Legal residents of the US (incl. territories) and Canada (excluding Quebec); registered MLB.com users; at least 21 years old and of age of majority. Winners provide ID, SSN and receive IRS 1099 for prizes of $600+.
mlb-beat-the-streak.dates: Entry period began on or about 2026-03-24 and ends upon the conclusion of the final game of the 2026 MLB regular season
notes: Rules tie the entry window to the 2026 regular season. Whether the 2026 contest is still accepting entries was not confirmed from an official source — check the official page.
